found: pre-release fuzzing, 2026-09-26 (cli-args target, initial campaign seed 11)
description: irontrellis revoke with an identifier holding an unpaired surrogate is a USAGE-level INVALID_INPUT, not the unclassified FAILED (possible on Windows, where argv is UTF-16).
rootCause: The CLI's checkIdentifier and the owner API's identifier() (packages/core/src/input.ts) checked length and control characters but not well-formedness, so the id reached the owner write (event capture), whose canonical capture threw a raw CanonicalError: the CLI printed error FAILED and the owner API broke its "errors are IronTrellisError" contract.
fix: input.ts identifier() requires a well-formed ProtocolString (INVALID_INPUT); the CLI checkIdentifier rejects it first with a message naming the argument.
